expected.description: Edge case: the Concept relationship is declared via @AssociationOverride on a generic BaseAttribute<ConceptAttributeType, Concept> superclass, not as a direct @ManyToOne on this class. The pack's relationship detector only inspects direct annotations and misses the generic-parameter override. Gap-fill should recover this by reading @AssociationOverride + the generic supertype.
